summary:
CODE NOVA is a web-based 2D space mission simulation game developed using standard web technologies: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.

How it works:
- Mission Planning & Physics: Players calculate orbital insertion trajectories, monitor fuel consumption vs. payload weight, and execute station-keeping maneuvers.
- Interactive Gameplay: Simple, responsive controls allow users to test different rocket configurations and orbital angles in real-time.
- Educational Value: The game visualizes concepts like gravity wells, escape velocity, and satellite deployment in a digestible format for students and space enthusiasts.

Technical Details & Tools:
- Technologies: HTML5 Canvas for rendering, pure JavaScript for custom 2D physics and orbital calculations, CSS3 for the responsive UI.
- Compatibility: Lightweight single-file architecture designed to run smoothly on any browser without external heavy engine dependencies.

Team Contribution:
Created by team CODE NOVA for the Space Mission Design Game challenge.
